title: Ownership / two-team handoff / detached stop (tmux, fake forge, two sandbox teams on one repo): one writer and untrusted claims ignored; drain then abort keeps the owner; a lost offer response retries to one post; partial reconcile holds the diverged set, flags the stale in-transit marker, kept run and rule difference; a lost ack response acks once; the stop typed in the session posts stopped only after the session and watcher are gone, keeping unlanded work; return in stop mode leaves rounds untouched; a mid-way takeover reuses the handoff id; the detached stop repeated 20 times under parallel load

steps.name: two-teams-one-writer
steps.run:
C="python3 {source}/cli/mdstack"; R=$(cd {state_dir}/.. && pwd -P); G={state_dir}/gh; O=$R/origin.git; A="--project $CREW_PROJECT --org-profile {state_dir}/team-a.toml"; B="--project $R/repo-b/crew.toml --org-profile {state_dir}/team-b.toml"; SA={state_dir}/campaign__sandbox-{run_id}; SB=$R/team-b/state/campaign__sandbox-{run_id}; TA=crew-campaign-{run_id}; TB=crew-campaign-{run_id}-b; posts() { python3 -c "import json,re,sys; st,h,f=sys.argv[1:]; [print(c['probe']) for c in json.load(open(f))['issues/1/comments'] if re.search(r'pass=handoff handoff=(%s) state=%s ' % (h, st), c['body'])]" "$1" "${2:-[0-9a-f-]+}" $G/api.json; }; body() { python3 -c "import json,re,sys; st,h,f=sys.argv[1:]; [print(c['body']) for c in json.load(open(f))['issues/1/comments'] if re.search(r'handoff=%s state=%s ' % (h, st), c['body'])]" "$1" "$2" $G/api.json; }; n() { posts "$@" | wc -l | tr -d ' '; }; total() { python3 -c "import json,sys; print(len(json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))['issues/1/comments']))" $G/api.json; }; hid() { python3 -c "import json,re,sys; print(re.findall(r'handoff=(\S+) state=(?:draining|takeover) ', ' '.join(c['body'] for c in json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))['issues/1/comments']))[-1])" $G/api.json; }; api() { python3 -c "import fcntl,json,sys; f=open(sys.argv[1],'r+'); fcntl.flock(f,2); d=json.load(f); exec(sys.argv[2]); f.seek(0); f.truncate(); json.dump(d,f)" $G/api.json "$1"; }; sess() { tmux has-session -t "=$1" 2>/dev/null; }; stopin() { printf 'export CAMPAIGN_GH_DIR=%s PATH="%s"
